$comment: The Git the Microsoft Store package carries (PKG-13, D-228): GitHub Desktop's dugite-native build, pinned by SHA-256. tools/release/git-bundle.mjs fetches, verifies and unpacks it into apps/desktop/vendor/git; dist-store.mjs puts it in the package at resources/git. To update: node tools/release/git-bundle.mjs --latest, then change every field here and run node tools/notices.mjs.

components.name: Git for Windows
components.what: `git.exe` and the programs it runs, in `resources\git\cmd`, `resources\git\ucrt64\bin` and `resources\git\ucrt64\libexec\git-core`. Its license is `resources\git\LICENSE.txt`.

components.name: Git for Windows' runtime
components.what: The MSYS2 runtime and the libraries Git uses (OpenSSL, curl, zlib, SQLite, OpenSSH and others), in `resources\git\usr` and `resources\git\ucrt64`. Each one's license is in `resources\git\usr\share\licenses` or beside it.

components.name: Git Credential Manager
components.what: Git's sign-in helper, which keeps the GitHub sign-in in Windows Credential Manager, in `resources\git\ucrt64\bin`. Its license and notices are in `resources\git\ucrt64\doc\git-credential-manager`.

components.name: dugite-native
components.what: GitHub Desktop's build of the programs above, unmodified, as one archive.
